title: Stanford bunny (generated)
author: Marcel Padilla
attribution: Input derived from the Stanford Bunny STL by Makerbot (via Wikimedia Commons, File:Stanford_Bunny.stl), CC BY 3.0.

generation.input: one rendered view of the bunny_render object (a matte, textured Blender frame)
generation.note: companion to bunny_render: same object, made by image-to-3d generation instead of render+train. A better-lit textured input than a plain grey render, so the colour survives.

caveats: GENERATED, not a photographic capture: one rendered view in, a whole object out. The unseen hemisphere is invented, and colour on the back is muddier.

Its input was a render of a CC BY 3.0 mesh (credit Makerbot as above), but the model invents geometry from an undisclosed corpus, so the output is released as-is, with no warranty of rights (NOT under CC-BY).
Spherical harmonics dropped; scale is not metric; no ground truth, so no PSNR/SSIM.
